hero.title: 全新项目开发应用
hero.summary: 面向项目冷启动阶段的具体应用，优先处理需求摄入、架构设计、模块边界和后续可持续开发。

taskTemplates.title: 启动一个新项目
taskTemplates.goal: 输入产品目标、用户场景和技术约束，生成架构方案并开始实现第一版。
taskTemplates.description: 适合从零搭建项目或模块。
exampleTasks: 我要做一个个人读书笔记网站，请从需求、页面、数据结构到第一版实现帮我启动。
帮我把“团队任务看板”的想法变成可运行的项目，先做登录、任务列表和状态切换。
我有一个旧 Excel 流程想做成网页工具，请先梳理功能范围并搭建最小可用版本。
expectedOutputs: 第一版范围：目标用户、核心流程、暂不做的功能和验收标准。
实现方案：页面或接口清单、数据结构、模块边界和技术选择理由。
可执行任务拆分：优先级、开发顺序、验证方式和下一步交付清单。

taskTemplates.title: 把原型做成可用应用
taskTemplates.goal: 输入草图、截图或功能描述，让应用补齐交互细节并实现可试用版本。
taskTemplates.description: 适合从产品原型、页面想法或单个工具切入开发。
exampleTasks: 我有一个仪表盘截图，请帮我实现页面、筛选器和列表交互。
请把这个表单工具做成网页应用，用户能填写、保存、编辑并导出结果。
我想做一个本地文件整理工具，请先实现选择目录、规则配置和预览结果。
expectedOutputs: 交互说明：用户入口、关键操作、异常状态和空状态处理。
可运行实现：主要页面、基础数据流和必要的本地验证。
体验检查清单：移动端适配、错误提示、加载状态和需要继续打磨的点。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 把产品原型推进到可试用版本

taskTemplates.title: 搭建项目基础
taskTemplates.goal: 输入应用类型、团队习惯和质量要求，让应用建立清晰的目录、开发规则和验证流程。
taskTemplates.description: 适合在正式开发前先把项目骨架、边界和基础设施立稳。
exampleTasks: 请为一个小型后台管理系统搭建前端项目基础，包含路由、布局、状态和测试约定。
我要做一个 Node.js 接口服务，请建立目录结构、配置管理、日志和基础测试。
帮我为一个长期维护的工具项目制定开发规范，并生成首批文件。
expectedOutputs: 项目骨架：目录用途、入口文件、配置文件和新增模块的位置。
开发规则：命名、错误处理、测试范围、代码风格和禁用的临时做法。
验证命令：安装、启动、测试、构建以及失败时的排查顺序。
taskTemplates.currentObjective: 建立可持续开发的项目基础

hero.title: New Project Development
hero.summary: A focused application for a project's cold start. It prioritizes requirement intake, architecture design, module boundaries, and sustainable follow-on development.

taskTemplates.title: Start a new project
taskTemplates.goal: Provide the product goal, user scenarios, and technical constraints to generate an architecture plan and begin the first implementation.
taskTemplates.description: For building a project or module from scratch.
exampleTasks: I want to build a personal reading-notes website. Help me start with requirements, pages, data structures, and a first implementation.
Turn my idea for a team task board into a runnable project. Start with sign-in, a task list, and status changes.
I want to turn an old Excel workflow into a web tool. First define the functional scope and build a minimum viable version.
expectedOutputs: First-release scope: target users, core flows, features to defer, and acceptance criteria.
Implementation plan: page or API inventory, data model, module boundaries, and rationale for technical choices.
Executable work breakdown: priorities, development order, validation method, and next deliverables.
taskTemplates.currentObjective: Design and start a new project

taskTemplates.title: Turn a prototype into a working app
taskTemplates.goal: Provide a sketch, screenshot, or feature description so the application can complete interaction details and build a trial-ready version.
taskTemplates.description: For starting development from a product prototype, page idea, or single-purpose tool.
exampleTasks: I have a dashboard screenshot. Help me build the page, filters, and list interactions.
Turn this form tool into a web app where users can fill it in, save, edit, and export results.
I want a local file-organizing tool. First implement directory selection, rule configuration, and a result preview.
expectedOutputs: Interaction specification: entry points, key actions, error states, and empty states.
Runnable implementation: primary pages, basic data flow, and necessary local validation.
Experience checklist: mobile adaptation, error messages, loading states, and areas that need more polish.
taskTemplates.currentObjective: Move a product prototype to a trial-ready version

taskTemplates.title: Establish the project foundation
taskTemplates.goal: Provide the application type, team conventions, and quality requirements so the application can establish a clear structure, development rules, and validation flow.
taskTemplates.description: For stabilizing the project skeleton, boundaries, and foundations before full development.
exampleTasks: Set up the frontend foundation for a small admin system, including routing, layout, state, and testing conventions.
I want a Node.js API service. Establish the directory structure, configuration management, logging, and baseline tests.
Create development conventions for a long-lived tool project and generate the first set of files.
expectedOutputs: Project skeleton: directory purposes, entry files, configuration files, and where new modules belong.
Development rules: naming, error handling, test scope, code style, and prohibited temporary practices.
Validation commands: installation, startup, tests, builds, and the troubleshooting order when failures occur.
